name: Outlook (Rui)
description: Search, read, send, draft and organize Outlook and Microsoft 365 email, and read and manage Outlook calendar events. Uses Microsoft Graph through Cindy-managed OAuth; connect an account in the plugin details page first. Existing accounts reconnect once to grant calendar access.
whenToUse: Use for Outlook, Hotmail, Live or Microsoft 365 mail and calendar: search, read, send, draft or organize mail; list, search, create, update, delete or answer calendar events and check free/busy. Every calendar change asks the user to confirm.

tools.name: outlook_accounts
tools.description: List connected accounts, the default account and application setup status. Multiple accounts can stay signed in at once. Optionally pass profile_account to read that account's mail and user_principal_name through a read-only Graph query. A sign-in name is not necessarily the receiving address; do not guess when mail is empty. Reads no mail and returns no tokens.

profile_account.description: Optional: an account ID returned by this tool. Only when given, reads that account's Graph mail (may be empty) and user_principal_name. Never treat the sign-in name as the receiving address.

tools.name: outlook_mail
tools.description: Search, read, send, save drafts, list folders, mark read/unread and move messages. Send, draft and organize actions must come from explicit user intent; before sending, verify the sender account, recipients and content. A successful send only means Microsoft accepted the request, not that it was delivered; if the result is unknown, check the mailbox first and do not retry directly. read does not mark messages read; page tokens are bound to the account and action. Microsoft cloud mailboxes only; other providers and on-premises Exchange are not supported.

account.description: Account ID returned by outlook_accounts. Verify the sender account before sending; if omitted, the default account is used.

cloud.description: Service region; only global (Outlook / Microsoft 365) is supported. Optional; the region is detected from account when given.

query.description: search: Microsoft KQL full-text search, e.g. from:person@example.test. Cannot be combined with from/subject/unread/since/before; Microsoft full-text search returns at most 1000 messages.

subject.description: search: subject contains this text; send/draft: subject, empty string allowed.

unread.description: search: true for unread, false for read, omit for no filter.

since.description: search: inclusive start time; ISO dates are UTC, times must include a time zone.

before.description: search: exclusive end time; ISO dates are UTC, times must include a time zone.

folder.description: search: limit to this folder; list_folders: list its child folders. If omitted, all mail / the root folders respectively. Use an ID from a query or a Microsoft well-known name such as inbox, sentitems or drafts.

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous page, passed back unchanged. Use the same action, account and cloud; when paging, do not also pass filters or max_results.

message_id.description: read/mark_read/mark_unread/move: the original message ID. After a move, use the returned new ID.

target_folder.description: move: target folder ID or Microsoft well-known name. For custom folders, find the ID with list_folders first.

body_text.description: send/draft: plain-text body, empty string allowed. Total request size must not exceed 250 KB.

to.description: send/draft: to email addresses as an array or comma/semicolon-separated text, without display names. At most 100 recipients in total.

cc.description: send/draft: cc email addresses as an array or comma/semicolon-separated text, without display names. At most 100 recipients in total.

bcc.description: send/draft: bcc email addresses as an array or comma/semicolon-separated text, without display names. At most 100 recipients in total.

tools.name: outlook_calendar
tools.description: Outlook calendar for the same Microsoft accounts. Reads: list_calendars; list_events and search_events in a required start/end range (max 92 days; search matches subject, location, preview and people); get_event; free_busy (work or school accounts, max 31 days). Writes: create_event, update_event, delete_event, respond_event (accept/tentative/decline); each one shows the user a Cindy confirmation first and does nothing if declined. Adding attendees on create or update SENDS invitations; updating or deleting a meeting you organize SENDS updates or cancellations to its attendees. Times in results are in time_zone (IANA or Windows name, default UTC); the result says which zone. If execution_status is unknown, check the calendar before retrying. RECONNECT_REQUIRED means the account must be reconnected once in the plugin details to grant calendar access.

account.description: Account ID returned by outlook_accounts; if omitted, the default account is used.

cloud.description: Service region; only global is supported. Optional.

calendar_id.description: list_events/search_events/create_event: calendar ID from list_calendars. Omit for the default calendar.

event_id.description: get_event/update_event/delete_event/respond_event: event ID returned by this tool.

start.description: Range reads and free_busy: ISO date (UTC midnight) or date-time with Z or an offset. create/update: local time like 2026-11-03T14:00 with time_zone, or a date-time with an offset; for is_all_day use YYYY-MM-DD.

end.description: Exclusive end, same form as start; must be later than start. For all-day events use the day after the last day.

time_zone.description: IANA (America/Sao_Paulo) or Windows (E. South America Standard Time) zone. Reads return times in it; create/update read local start/end in it. Default UTC.

query.description: search_events: text to find in subject, location, body preview, organizer or attendees (case-insensitive).

max_results.description: Results per page (list_events default 25; search_events stops after at least this many matches).

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous call, unchanged. Pass only action, account, cloud and page_token.

is_all_day.description: create_event/update_event: all-day event; start/end must be dates.

is_online_meeting.description: create_event/update_event: request an online meeting link from the account's default provider.

attendees.description: create_event/update_event: required attendee email addresses. Microsoft SENDS them an invitation. On update this REPLACES the whole attendee list.

optional_attendees.description: create_event/update_event: optional attendee email addresses; they also get an invitation.

emails.description: free_busy: up to 20 addresses; omit for your own calendar.

interval_minutes.description: free_busy: slot length for availability_view, default 30.

response.description: respond_event: your answer to an invitation.

comment.description: respond_event: optional note to the organizer.

send_response.description: respond_event: send the answer to the organizer (default true).

author: Rui Valim

secrets.label: Microsoft account (global)
secrets.hint: Connect an account in the plugin details page. Accounts added before calendar support must reconnect once to grant calendar access; work accounts may need admin approval.
